Are you going to order a total of 3 items with your dad? … Afterwards, he talked about air rice and I said I could add air rice if he wanted. Because it really makes no sense. Nevertheless, I tried to go in and order, but they said I couldn't order the grilled mackerel for the babies because it wasn't ready... . and… So I just came out. It is a pork specialty restaurant located near Bongeunsa intersection in Samseong-dong, Gangnam-gu. It is the Samseong branch of Heukdonga in Nohyeong-dong, Jeju-si and serves black pork and seasoned charcoal grilling.

It is located in a convenient location, has easy parking, and is a large restaurant that serves the taste of Jeju's black pork, so it seems to attract a lot of customers.

It's been a while since I visited for lunch and made a reservation...
First of all, my personal evaluation of this place was that I honestly didn't understand why people would pay this much money to eat at a place like this.

In fact, the Jeju main branch is also large in size, but it is not very recognized or highly regarded by locals, but this place seems to be even more so. I don't know if it was just that day, but the quality and size of all the meat was poor, and the meat in the set menu was especially bad, to the point where it was suspicious that it was raw meat.
It made me wonder, what would it be like if this place were in Jeju?

Sorry, I'm just saying my personal feelings as they are, but I think people who have tried various black pork restaurants in Jeju Island will probably sympathize.

Still, seeing as they have been doing business here for a long time, I think it will definitely be different from today's feeling, but I personally don't think I will ever visit again.

Can you see the ice crystals in the picture? I don't know how long I kept it,
We went to eat raw meat, not frozen meat. It would have been better to at least freeze it to maintain freshness.

Consumers who went to eat raw black pork only felt a chewy texture like rubber that had lost all of its juice, worse than the 3,000 or 4,000 won price from Chile.
It was so hard to eat the neck meat that I ordered extra pork belly. I couldn't take a picture of this, but they only gave me the fat part, so I had to order it and get it again.
Sure enough, this is also a mess.
I'm sorry for saying it's a mess, but it really is a mess.
The fleshy part of the meat is so broken and damaged that it becomes like muk-tae even when it is slightly cooked. Crunchy.
Do you understand?

I think you need to be careful about material management. I think this is a clear deception to consumers.

Or lower the price!!!!!!!!!!!!

I can't help but think that the meat sellers knew that the ingredients were in poor condition, but served them out with the complacent mindset of 'people will eat them anyway'.

We acknowledge that due to the butchery system, the condition of the meat delivered to each table may be different even if it is the same cut. But please remember that I am in no way criticizing this.

Additionally, can you see the state of the cold noodles?? I won't say any more. It's getting too long.
The black pork family that I have admired so much since I was young is now in ruin. Oh, of course, only the Samsung branch!

#Samseong-dong #Seongbuk-dong Cheonggukjang

“Stimulation that doesn’t change”

There are restaurants that provide more stimulation than the taste of the ingredients.
Seongbuk-dong Cheonggukjang, located in Samseong-dong, is a typical example, and perhaps because of its stimulation, it continues to be loved.
Especially at gatherings where alcohol is involved.

The stimulation already begins with the side dishes.
Delicious inanimate objects are the signature of this house.
Green onion salad also contains seasoning: it tastes like mixing green onion into ramen soup, which is unique.
Dongchimi is the element that cleanses the mouth.

A touch of seasoning is also added to the ribs.
Raw ribs, which are not raw ribs, seem to have the savory flavor of ribs and are perfect as a side dish for drinks.

What about cheonggukjang?
The enormous size of tofu, which is the exclusive patent of this restaurant, is overwhelming, and the kimchi stew-like #cheonggukjang is a stimulating finish.

It feels like a good restaurant, but it's not a good restaurant.
A home stimulated by stimulation
A house that I keep saying I don't go every time, but go to once every few years to get that stimulation.

It is clearly a house with a positive function.

reviews.text:
“For this restaurant, boiled bean sprout hangover soup is the answer.”

1. There are a few restaurants in the neighborhood that are open 24 hours a day, and this one is one of those restaurants that I am thankful for. Now that it is a franchised Hyundai Ok, it is not a place worthy of being considered a good restaurant, but for me, who usually only eats bean sprout hangover soup, the food at this restaurant did not suit my taste.

2. My wife loves boiling, so whenever she comes to this house, she always orders boiled bean sprout hangover soup. This time, I followed her and ordered boiled. Of course, add 1,500 won and add squid topping...

3. If you order a boiled meal, an egg is added to the hangover soup instead of a poached egg. The eggs cook deliciously in the bubbling hot hangover soup, so it's great to eat after the middle of the meal.
The soup is hotter than Toryeomsik, so it feels less salty and the seasoning tastes a little lighter. The egg yolk spreads out and gives a soft taste, so the taste is milder than that of Toryeom-sik.

4. It was late at night, and I don't know if it was because there were only our tables with customers due to the coronavirus, but the lady serving us was very kind and cheerful. It wasn't such a friendly atmosphere when it was busy in the past, but I was able to have a pleasant meal anyway.
Moreover, this house has started to be sold. For me, a Hallasan soju enthusiast, there is no better news than this haha.

5. I hope you will continue to remain as a 24-hour neighborhood guardian for a long time.

reviews.text:
#Samseong-dong #Ujeong Beef Ribs

“Sweet, sweet, sweet, sweet friendship”

Woojung Beef Ribs was under construction near my house and opened.
I discovered this place while walking around Apgujeong Rodeo a while ago, and seeing that there were quite a few customers, I was excited about the new place opening in front of my house.
The lack of good meat restaurants in the area also raises expectations.

Because it is a newly opened store, the interior is clean.
I thought it was grilled with briquettes since there were briquettes as decoration, but it turned out to be #gugongtan.
I feel like I was tricked haha
But the fire is so strong. As a seasoning grill, it is a complete failure.
In fact, even though I am quite a griller, I grilled the meat with great difficulty.

A lot of chopped garlic caught my eye, but there was no other place that tasted so much garlic.
It's the same here too. I can't taste the garlic at all, but the sweetness hits me sharply.
It is the sweetest of all the seasoned meats I have ever eaten in my life.
Roasting sweet meat further condenses the sweetness, making it extremely sweet.

As expected, the sweet and strong raw meat was served as a service.
Sweet onion sauce.
Sweet seasoning sauce
It is a sweet paradise.
The less sweet things are Chinese cabbage kimchi, salt, and soybean paste.

The soybean paste stew I ordered just in case was also very sweet.
At first, it had a strong taste and a taste of cooking ingredients, but as I continued to eat foods with strong sweetness, the taste of soybean paste stew also became more sweet.
There is no rest for the tongue.
Moreover, I think this is a new store that prepares dried ssam vegetables properly.

There is something called an open cafe, but even when it is open, there are a lot of empty seats.
If things continue like this, I wonder if I can last long.
Because it is a franchise, you will be supplied with sauce, but the last person to provide it will be the branch manager, so please carefully analyze the taste of the food in your store and the freshness of the side dishes.

It may be because Budae Jjigae is a lunch menu item, but the hot weather may also have played a role.

Anyway, the special feature of this house’s budae-jjigae is beef pork belly and green onion salad.

reviews.author: YennaPPa (Luscious.K)
reviews.text:
#Samseong-dong #Gomeram

“Lamb specialty restaurant with a neat atmosphere”

Among the Samseong-dong restaurants, Gourmeram is the most famous place for lamb.
As you can see from the name, I expected it to be a luxurious lamb rib restaurant, but when I visited this time, it had a black chic interior reminiscent of a local area with many office workers, and there were table and table seats.

In addition to lamb, this restaurant has unique menu items such as red pepper cod roe rice, gourmet soup, and Kuromayu bibim noodles.
The side dishes are quite famous, so it's worth ordering at least one at every table while eating the meat.

#lamb
The meat is of good quality and has no odor, a taste that Koreans like.
Shoulder rack and French rack are all good, and salchi and sirloin are also delicious.
The assortment comes with beef tongue, and although it has a similar texture to beef tongue or pork tongue, the pieces are small and not as satisfying.
It seems like it should be a little thicker and larger.
It's a good experience.

Instead, our griller is not as good at grilling as we thought.
He's busy, but he can't tell.
I don't know if it's because it's charcoal and Genghis Khan grilling board, but my mouth feels like it's undercooked.
In particular, the griller's skills are disappointing when it comes to bone meat.

#gourmet soup
The right amount of spices, meat, and rich hotpot flavor are good.
It's like Ramland's lamb leg hotpot that has been boiled and concentrated.
However, the flavor of the seasoning is too much so I can't eat much.
It is delicious when eaten with rice.

#Kuromayu mixed noodles
It feels greasy.
Kuroma oil is black garlic oil, but it smells like perilla oil.
In addition, seaweed powder, perilla powder, and sesame seeds are added, so it is delicious, but not clean.

#red pepper pollack roe rice
This is the most delicious.
It also goes well with lamb.
There's no way it wouldn't taste good mixed with cool peppers, which are full of seasonings.
The flavor of the seasoning is strong, but the peppers work hard.

#side dish
They serve Japanese-style pickled side dishes, but since they are all pickles with commercial seasoning, the first taste is strong, so they are good as a side dish with drinks, but they don't last long.
Rather, it interferes with the taste of the meat.

#seasoning
The meat is okay and the interior is nice, but the seasoning on the food and side dishes is too much.
That is the biggest drawback of this house.
So it’s a shame to recognize it as the best.

Order the Korean beef special course
- Consisting of special tenderloin, Seolhwa sirloin, skirt meat, and Korean beef sashimi (total 600g / KRW 198,000)

First, side dishes and Korean beef stew were served.
The raw fish is definitely fresh and delicious, unlike other places, and the combination with egg yolk is the best.. haha
Personally, among the side dishes here, I highly recommend the crunchy red pepper salad!!

Roast garlic and garlic sprouts(?) with oil, and grill in the following order: tenderloin -> sirloin -> skirt.

The combination of salt + cheese for tenderloin and wasabi goes well with sirloin, and personally, sirloin tastes better. (Sirloin is also more expensive)

For my meal, I additionally ordered bibim cold noodles and Korean beef Chapagetti ramen... . The amount of Chapagetti is almost 2 servings, but the noodles felt a little undercooked...

The Korean beef special course + meal is a bit too much for 2 people, but would be appropriate for 3 people.

FYI, corkage is free here, so it's great for a dinner party or small gathering with wine or whiskey in the evening.

Sherbet provided as a finishing touch… Good!!

reviews.text:
A 5-star restaurant after a long time. Even though I usually pass by, I couldn't go in because I thought the price would be a bit high for lunch, but I came here because I had something to treat.

It turned out that this place required a reservation, but luckily I was able to get a seat without having to wait long.

There are only two menu items: Hitsumabushi and Unadon. Hitsumabushi is an eel rice bowl that can be eaten with three types of seasoning (wasabi, chives, and seaweed powder) and dashi broth (ochazuke), while unadon is a simple rice bowl meal. If this is your first time visiting, we recommend Hitsumabushi, which allows you to enjoy a variety of flavors even if you spend a little more money.

It explains how to taste it in four steps, so it would be a good idea to try it out first. In terms of gain, I liked eating it with ochazuke. The rice bowl served without any seasoning was also good. Try a variety of foods to find your taste.

The price cannot be considered cheap, but considering that you can eat an eel at this price elsewhere, it is difficult to say that it is expensive.

It is said to be a direct store operated by the Nagoya main branch, and the staff are friendly and explain the food well. However, the store is narrow and the spacing between tables is narrow, so it is not an atmosphere where you can eat comfortably. Still, the store is clean and has the feel of a traditional Japanese restaurant.

The main alcoholic beverages were sake and wine, but it was disappointing that there was no tokuri or sake.

This is a recommended place for anyone looking for a hearty and delicious meal.
